start: New member, no routines in any folder, Workout tab open (not the demo)

steps.action: Look at the Workout tab
user_sees: 'A routine is the list of exercises you do on one day. We will help you make one in 4 short steps.'
Buttons 'Make a routine' and 'Skip for now'
must_not: The card shows for a member who already has routines
The card flashes and goes while the mark is read

steps.action: Tap 'Make a routine'; keep 'My plan' as the folder name, tap Next
user_sees: 'A folder keeps your routines together, like a plan for your week.'
must_not: Next is tappable with an empty name

steps.action: Tap the ready name 'Push Day', tap Next
user_sees: Ready names Push Day, Pull Day, Leg Day, Upper Body, Lower Body, Full Body
must_not: The typed name is lost when going back a step

steps.action: Tick two exercises, tap 'Next (2 picked)'
must_not: Next works with no exercise picked

steps.action: On 'Check and save' tap 'Save routine'
user_sees: 'Each exercise starts with 3 sets. You can change sets and order any time.'
Back on the Workout tab, folder 'My plan' open with routine 'Push Day'
must_not: Two 'My plan' folders
The card comes back on the next open
The folder is set as followed without the member asking

start: Guide on step 2, member types an own routine name

steps.action: Type 'Chest and triceps' instead of tapping a ready name, go on and save
user_sees: The routine saved as 'Chest and triceps'
must_not: The routine saved as a full-body day when the name says chest (push)
Inner double spaces kept in the saved name

start: Guide open on step 3 with nothing picked

steps.action: Look at the main button
user_sees: Button reads 'Pick at least 1 exercise' and does nothing
must_not: The guide moves to step 4 with no exercise

steps.action: Clear the folder name on step 1 (only spaces) and tap Next
must_not: A folder saved with a blank name

steps.action: Save on step 4 while the save fails
user_sees: The guide stays on step 4 with the picks kept
must_not: An empty 'My plan' folder left behind
The card marked done although nothing was saved

start: Card showing; member taps Skip in the guide after picking exercises

steps.action: Open the guide, pick 2 exercises, tap 'Skip'
user_sees: 'Your routine is not saved yet. You can still make one any time with New routine.'
must_not: Picks lost with no question

steps.action: Tap 'Leave'
user_sees: Workout tab without the first-routine card
must_not: The card returns on the next open

steps.action: Later make routines, then delete every routine
must_not: The card comes back after deleting all routines

steps.action: Save the routine; open the gym panel as the gym
user_sees: The routine stays on the phone (a cloud copy only if the member signed in)
must_not: The gym sees the routine without the member sharing
The guide or its routines put behind a paid plan
